info.title: Wink API
info.description:
Welcome to the Wink API — a programmer-friendly way to manage, sell and book travel
inventory on the Wink platform. See the **Overview** page (under **API**) for the full
introduction, intended audience, testing, and versioning.

# Channel Manager API
Wink exposes a secured REST-based, JSON API to its channel manager partners. The connection is "channel-wide". Partners are free to integrate with the REST-based API using any programming language.

# Intended Audience
This document is intended for external channel partners who wish to integrate with Wink.

# Requirements
- Active account with Wink. Sign up for your Channel Manager account:
   - Staging: [https://staging-app.wink.travel](https://staging-app.wink.travel).
   - Production: [https://app.wink.travel](https://app.wink.travel).
- Active application. An application provides you with Oauth2 credentials you can pass to our endpoints. One is already created for you upon account creation.
- Your production IP numbers. They need to be whitelisted before you can talk to our production environment.

# Performance
A particular attention to performance should be given when integrating with this API. A few things to be aware of:
- Enable gzip compression to make payloads smaller.
- Fewer large REST calls are preferred to many small ones. E.g. It is better to update many dates instead of individual dates.
- It is possible to update both rate and availability with a single request.
- Request only date ranges that you will use. There is no need to request an entire year if you will only be working with the first seven days.

## Reservation notification (PUSH)
Wink supports PUSH notifications to communicate reservations. We also support BASIC AUTH to your endpoint. If you want to enable PUSH, add your PUSH endpoint and credentials (optional) to your account.

CustomMonetaryAmount.description: Monetary amount with an associated ISO 4217 currency code, used at API boundaries where JSON-friendly serialization is needed

PropertyRateUpdateRequest.description: Request body for bulk-updating daily rates and availability for a master rate over a date range

startDate.description: Start date for rate update range (inclusive)

endDate.description: End date for rate update range (inclusive)

amount.description: Updated daily rate amount (optional; omit to preserve current amounts)

currencyCode.description: Currency code for rate amount (optional; defaults to property currency)

master.description: Whether to update this as a master rate

closedOnArrival.description: Whether to close the rate on arrival dates

closedOnDeparture.description: Whether to close the rate on departure dates

quantity.description: Available quantity/inventory for each date in range (optional)

minLengthOfStay.description: Minimum length of stay requirement in nights (optional)

maxLengthOfStay.description: Maximum length of stay limit in nights (optional)

singleOccupancyRateModifier.description: Single occupancy rate modifier (JSON representation of VariableCharge, optional)

extraPaxRateModifier.description: Extra occupant rate modifier (JSON representation of VariableCharge, optional)

extraChildRateModifier.description: Extra child rate modifier (JSON representation of VariableCharge, optional)

type.description: When the type is FIXED, fixedAmount is required. When the type is PERCENTAGE, percent is required.

percent.description: A fraction between 0 and 1 (inclusive) representing a percentage of the total stay amount for an early check-in or late check-out, e.g. 0.25 for 25%. Direction (surcharge vs. discount) is determined by which field this charge is assigned to, not the sign of this value.

fixedAmount.description: A localized amount, always non-negative. Direction (surcharge vs. discount) is determined by which field this charge is assigned to, not the sign of this value.

PropertyRate.description: A single daily rate entry for a master rate, including availability, stay restrictions, and optional occupancy modifiers

master.description: Whether this is a master (template) rate

closedOnArrival.description: Whether the rate is closed on arrival

closedOnDeparture.description: Whether the rate is closed on departure

minOccupancy.description: Minimum occupancy required for this date

maxOccupancy.description: Maximum occupancy allowed for this date

minLengthOfStay.description: Minimum length of stay (in nights) for this date

maxLengthOfStay.description: Maximum length of stay (in nights) for this date

singleOccupancyRateModifier.description: Single occupancy rate modifier (JSON representation of VariableCharge)

extraPaxRateModifier.description: Extra occupant rate modifier (JSON representation of VariableCharge)

extraChildRateModifier.description: Extra child rate modifier (JSON representation of VariableCharge)

ChannelManagerProperty.description: Property entry returned by the channel manager API, containing the property's identity, location, and currency settings

city.description: City property is located in or near

countryCode.description: Country code property is located in

PropertyRoomRate.description: A master rate combining a room type and a rate plan, including occupancy limits and base rate modifiers

name.description: Master rate name (room type + rate plan)

minOccupancy.description: Minimum occupancy for this room type

maxOccupancy.description: Maximum occupancy for this room type

maxAdultOccupancy.description: Maximum number of adults allowed in this room type

maxChildOccupancy.description: Maximum number of children allowed in this room type

includedAdultOccupancy.description: Number of adults the base rate price is calculated for

includedChildOccupancy.description: Number of children the base rate price is calculated for

baseRate.description: Base nightly rate in high-demand period

singleOccupancyRateModifier.description: Rate modifier for single occupancy (JSON representation of VariableCharge)

extraPaxRateModifier.description: Rate modifier for extra occupants (JSON representation of VariableCharge)

extraChildRateModifier.description: Rate modifier for extra children (JSON representation of VariableCharge)

PropertyWithRoomRateList.description: A property together with its complete list of master rates (room type + rate plan combinations)

list.description: List of master rates (room type + rate plan combinations) for this property

PropertyRoomRateWithRateList.description: A master rate together with the daily rates for the queried date range

room.description: Master rate details (room type + rate plan)

rates.description: Daily rates for the queried date range

startDate.description: Start date of the queried range (inclusive)

endDate.description: End date of the queried range (inclusive)

PropertyBooking.description: A single booking for a property: guest details, payment status, the net sales total, and one room-stay entry per booked room

totalAmount.description: Net sales total in supplier currency — the amount the hotel receives for the entire booking (all rooms)

cancelDate.description: Timestamp when booking was cancelled (null if not cancelled)

paymentMethodType.description: Payment method type (e.g. Card, Direct Debit)

paymentWalletType.description: Payment wallet provider if applicable (e.g. Google Pay, Apple Pay)

paymentMethodStatus.description: Booking lifecycle status. INITIALIZED: awaiting payment; TEST_PAYMENT_SUCCEEDED: test booking; PAYMENT_SUCCEEDED: payment confirmed; PAYMENT_FAILED: payment declined; FAILED: system failure post-payment; CANCELLED: cancelled by any party; PARTIALLY_REFUNDED: partial refund issued; FULLY_REFUNDED: full refund issued

roomStays.description: Per-room stay detail — one entry per physical room booked

PropertyBookingRoomStay.description: A single physical room within a booking, including its rate, occupancy, stay dates, and per-room net sales amount

adults.description: Number of adults in this room

children.description: Number of children in this room

guests.description: Total number of guests in this room (adults and children)

quantity.description: Total number of room types requested

amount.description: Net sales amount for this room in supplier currency (the booking's net sales total divided across its rooms)

PingResponse.description: Response returned by the ping endpoint confirming that credentials are valid

status.description: Account status. PENDING_APPROVAL: awaiting admin activation; ACTIVE: account is operational; INACTIVE: account has been deactivated; UNDER_REVIEW: account is being reviewed; SUSPENDED: account suspended due to policy violation; REJECTED: account application was rejected; REMOVED: account has been deleted

oauth2ClientCredentials.description:
Every endpoint is protected with OAuth2 **client credentials**. Create an
**Application** in your account to obtain a `clientId` and `clientSecret`, then
exchange them for a short-lived bearer token.

### 1. Request an access token
`POST` to the **Token URL** below with `Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded`
and a body of `grant_type=client_credentials` (optionally `scope=<space-separated scopes>`).
Send your credentials as HTTP Basic auth:
`Authorization: Basic base64(clientId + ":" + clientSecret)`.

### 2. Call the API
Pass the returned token on every request: `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`.

Tokens carry only the scopes granted to your Application — request the least privilege
you need. There is no interactive authorize step and no refresh token for this flow;
request a new token when the current one expires.
